meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能检索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先搜索拿到带 ID 的索引,再看某条结果前后的时间线,最后只取筛出的条目详情,避免一次拉取全部内容。
howto.when: 当你问「这个之前解决过吗」「上次是怎么做的」,或需要用到过往会话里的工作时触发;针对的是以前的会话,不是当前对话。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么解决登录报错的?搜一下记忆。
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的搜索结果列表

say.text: 搜这个项目里 bugfix 类型的记录,只要最近 20 条。
say.note: 用 search 过滤出索引,先不取详情

say.text: 把这条结果的时间线上下文和完整详情调出来。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: search for an index with IDs, view timeline context around a result, then fetch full details only for filtered IDs instead of pulling everything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we do X last time?", rather than the current conversation.

say_en.text: How did we fix that login error last time? Search memory.
say_en.note: Returns a search list with IDs first

say_en.text: Search this project for bugfix records, latest 20 only.
say_en.note: Uses search to filter an index before fetching

say_en.text: Show the timeline context and full details for that hit.
say_en.note: timeline for context, then get_observations for details
